title: Pack manifest, schema 2 (map/packs/<id>/manifest.json)
description: Kernel contract v2, docs/kernel-schema.md §2 (rules K-R01..K-R09, K-R63..K-R66). One pack = one JSON document. Only id, schema and title are required. Every block (nodes, views, vars, entities, items, events, layers, ui, llm, media) is either written inline here or given as a relative path to a JSON file that holds exactly that block; the block's own schema (v2/<block>.schema.json) validates it in both cases. cdn, legacy and x-page are honoured only for packs shipped with the engine; foreign packs (embedded, URL, file) have them ignored and pass extra limits (K-R63, K-R66). Keys starting with _ are comments; keys starting with x- are author extensions the kernel carries but never reads. Schema 1 (map/data/schema/pack.schema.json) stays frozen beside this one.

id.description: Pack id = folder name. Storage names derive from it unless legacy says otherwise (K-R05).

title.description: Pack title shown on the panel; also the default name of the root node when the pack has no nodes.

lang.description: Language of the pack's own words (aliases, hints, event labels). Picks the kernel vocabulary (transit, pickup, auto-discovery) and the injection template language. Default: the UI language at load time.

version.description: The pack's own version label (free text). Not the engine version.

features.description: Feature switch overrides (fog, trips, stash, …). Default: derived from which blocks exist. A foreign pack may only switch features off (K-R63).

cdn.description: Where the pack's asset files are served from (jsDelivr gh route / npm mirror). Default: the engine's own routes. Shipped packs only; the engine's code base always comes from the script's own URL, never from here (K-R63).

nodes.description: The node tree, the only geography (v2/nodes.schema.json). Absent = grown from chat (K-R26).

views.description: How nodes are drawn (v2/views.schema.json). Absent = schematic.

vars.description: MVU paths and time periods (v2/vars.schema.json). Absent = auto-discovery by field name.

entities.description: Roster groups, attribute fields, avatars (v2/entities.schema.json). Absent = name and place only.

items.description: World stash and pickup vocabulary (v2/items.schema.json). Absent = no world stash, kernel vocabulary.

events.description: Event taxonomy, what only (v2/events.schema.json). Absent = neutral default taxonomy.

layers.description: Declarative layers, reserved for S8 (v2/layers.schema.json). Absent = built-in default layers.

ui.description: Strings, theme, legend, tabs, start node (v2/ui.schema.json).

llm.description: Injection templates and worldbook add-on entries (v2/llm.schema.json).

media.description: Pack pictures: a table of media ids to sources (v2/media.schema.json, K-R101). Absent = no pictures.

transit.description: Transit network: modes, stations, lines, links, districts (v2/transit.schema.json, K-R107). Absent = no network.

path.description: Block file, relative to the manifest's folder: letters, digits, _ . / - only, no .. segment (so no scheme, no leading /, no %, no backslash).

match.description: Reserved for S9 (pack picked by card). Any listed value that matches the current card makes this pack a candidate; S9 defines ranking. Never required.

worldbook.description: Titles of worldbook entries the card carries.

credits.description: Who made what. The only place credits live; ui renders them (K-R08). card.* may be filled at run time from the card itself (the same bridge the credits page uses: name, creator, version).

lexicon.description: Per-language additions to the kernel word lists (K-R07). Literal words only; they extend the kernel lists and never remove from them.

to.description: Journey markers: the text after one is the destination (K-R19).

from.description: Journey markers paired with a to marker: <from> A <to> B.

articles.description: Leading articles stripped from default aliases and grown segments (K-R15, K-R26).

suffixes.description: Word-end suffixes allowed after a whole-word match (K-R15).

present.description: Values meaning 'with the player' in a roster row (K-R41).

head.description: Where the head of a place phrase sits; tie-break of K-R21, comma order of K-R26.

fields.description: Extra field names for auto-discovery (K-R38, K-R41).

legacy.description: Names this pack used before schema 2 (naming decision a, docs/naming.md). The engine reads the legacy name when the new one is empty and writes per `write` (K-R09). Honoured only for packs shipped with the engine (K-R63); reserved names (stat_data, display_data, delta_data, schema, another shipped pack's names) are refused.

worldbook_marker.description: Prefix of the extra.* ownership fields on our worldbook entries.

worldbook_book.description: Name prefix of our add-on worldbook.

event_attr.description: Legacy attribute of the hidden event span; stays parseable forever.

write.description: legacy = keep writing the legacy names (no migration yet); new = read legacy, write new. Default new.
